name: Chayanon Phakthin
bio: Chayanon Phakthin (Thai) is a member of the group BUS (Because Of You I Shine) under Sonray Music from Thailand. He is best known as a contestant on the reality survival show 789 SURVIVAL.

credits.title: Inherit
credits.overview: Follows a wealthy family whose polished exterior begins to crack when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their bloodline.
